width.description: Logical width of the chart image.

height.description: Logical height of the chart image.

title.description: A title to display at the top or left of the chart.

categoryAxisLabel.description: The label for the category axis (X axis for horizontal orientation).

valueAxisLabel.description: The label for the value axis (Y axis in horizontal orientation).

categoryLabels.description: Whether to put labels on the category axis (X axis).

valueLabels.description: Whether to put labels on the value axis (Y axis).

gridLines.description: Whether to draw min and maximum lines and labels on value axis.

points.description: Whether to draw an extra element at points in the line graph.

plotOrientation.description: The plot orientation (horizontal or vertical). Not all chart types will support vertical.

legend.description: Whether to display a legend alongside the chart. Not all chart types will support legends.

tooltips.description: Whether to generate tooltips at data points.

trend.description: Whether to display a linear regression trend line among the values.

includeZero.description: Whether to include 0 in the value axis, even if all values are positive.

maxValue.description: Include this value in the value axis, even if outside all the samples.

fillMissing.description: Whether to fill missing values or have gap in the line

lineStyle.description: CSS style for chart lines. The default is a solid black line.

unit.description: The unit used for rendering values in tool tips if the data set does not include dimensioned values.

xHighlights.description: Indexes in the data to be highlighted.
